briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI benchmarks as compute shortages intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases amid US export controls on advanced chips to China. Prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments while regulatory frameworks lag deployment pace.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V3 matches GPT-4o performance at 40% lower inference cost; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic systems following major jailbreaks on xAI Grok-3.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announces $15B data center expansion in Texas; TSMC begins 2nm production for NVIDIA B200 chips; Google TPU v6 pods reach 100k-chip scale for internal training runs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium before 2028?
